title: How to File Your Quarterly Tax and Wage Reports

passages.question: Which quarterly reports does ESD expect, and how is this one filed or a filed one changed?
passages.excerpt: Every employer in Washington needs to file 2 tax and wage reports each quarter. Washington employers need to file quarterly: A tax and wage report for unemployment insurance. A combined tax and wage report for paid leave and WA Cares. ... Log into SecureAccess Washington (SAW) to access EAMS and file a quarterly report online. ... Changing a report you filed ... Log into SecureAccess Washington (SAW) to access EAMS and make changes to your quarterly report.

passages.question: Which hours are reported for hourly and for salaried employees?
passages.excerpt: When reporting hours, round up to the next whole number. We don't accept any fractions of hours. Salaried employees: Report the actual hours an employee worked. If you don't track hours, report 40 hours per week for full-time employees. ... Severance pay, bonuses, tips and gratuities: Report zero (0) hours.
